picks.title: Officials: 1K fewer multilingual learners attend Delaware schools this year
picks.take: Delaware's Sept. 30 count shows about 1,000 fewer multilingual learners, out of roughly 19,000. State finance staff point to kindergarten and birth-rate declines; legislators and district EL leads point to immigration enforcement and family fear. Because EL counts drive funding, a quiet drop in enrollment or attendance hits exactly the schools serving newcomers.
picks.try: Pull your own EL roster against last fall's and flag any newcomer family who has gone quiet for a counselor check-in this week.

picks.title: Join Me For A Free Dec. 1st Webinar On Dual Language Instruction
picks.take: Ferlazzo is co-hosting a free Seidlitz Education webinar on December 1 built around La lotería del aula dual, a set of activities that fold listening, speaking, reading and writing into every lesson. Free, short, and aimed at classroom moves rather than theory, which is rare PD for Mississippi teachers who rarely see dual-language training.
picks.try: Register, then pick one lotería-style activity to run as a Spanish-English warm-up with your Emerging students next week.

picks.title: The Best “Words Of The Year” Features For 2026
picks.take: Ferlazzo's running list collects this year's Word of the Year announcements as dictionaries release them, starting with the Oxford shortlist, with links back to prior years. Word-of-the-year lists are a low-prep way to teach how meaning shifts, how slang and news feed vocabulary, and how to argue for a choice with evidence.
picks.try: Have students read the Oxford shortlist, pick one word, and write a three-sentence case for it as this year's word.
